titleBefore: Review your resume for a specific role before
description: AI Resume Review quickly shows how well your resume fits a vacancy, highlighting weak points, missing keywords, and concrete copy improvements.
previewText: Strengthen the summary for the target role, add more metrics, and move React, Next.js, and FSD higher in the resume.
capabilitiesText: More than a resume upload form: analyze and tailor a resume, translate it, compare roles, and export the result.
processText: The workflow is built for quick iterations: upload a resume, define the goal, apply improvements, and review the next version.
useCasesText: Make decisions based on a specific role and vacancy requirements instead of rewriting your resume blindly.
